name: clocks-and-alarms-online
description: High-precision web timekeeping, world clock, meeting planner, and synchronized countdown timer tools.

tools.name: get_world_time
tools.description: Get high-precision current local time, UTC offset, and Daylight Saving Time (DST) status for any timezone or city worldwide.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Kolkata) or city name.

tools.name: convert_timezone
tools.description: Convert a given date and time from a source timezone to a target timezone with exact offset calculations.

tools.name: calculate_meeting_overlap
tools.description: Find overlapping working hours and schedule convenient meeting windows across multiple timezones.

workingHoursStart.description: Standard business day start hour (0-23, default: 9)

workingHoursEnd.description: Standard business day end hour (0-23, default: 17)
